channel.title: Governance Digest: gnosis
channel.description: New DAO governance proposals and discussions, summarized in plain English.

item.title: GIP-[XXX]: Blockscout SLA and Hosting Renewal (January 2027 - December 2027) (gnosis)
item.description: A draft Gnosis funding proposal asks for $106,800 to renew Blockscout explorer hosting and SLA for 2027.

item.title: Zodiac Reality Module on the legacy Safe: Invalid or No? (gnosis)
item.description: A forum post says a question about a proposal that does not exist on Snapshot was submitted to the Reality module of GnosisDAO's legacy Safe, and argues the correct answer is No.

item.title: GIP 152 - Quarterly Investor/DAO Update 1 (gnosis)
item.description: The Gnosis team shares its first quarterly update: the Gnosis App is becoming Circles-first, with an alpha pilot in Kenya and a rebrand to the Circles App planned.

item.title: Should the gnosis DAO fund a Compensation Plan in GNO for Affected Users of Personal Data Leak? (gnosis)
item.description: A draft GIP asks GnosisDAO to fund up to 25,000 GNO so each verified user affected by a personal-data leak receives the equivalent of $500 in GNO.

item.title: GIP-XXX: Withdraw assets from the legacy DAO Safe (gnosis)
item.description: GnosisDAO draft proposes sweeping idle tokens and unclaimed rewards from its old Ethereum governance Safe into the current treasury Safe, about $1.7M by the author's estimate.

item.title: Should GnosisDAO fund an open-source integrity monitor for Gnosis bridges and consensus contracts? (gnosis)
item.description: A builder asks GnosisDAO to fund an open-source monitor that alerts when Gnosis bridge or consensus contracts are upgraded or their admins change. Retroactive pay plus an ongoing amount.
